guardrails: Economic-function classifications and peer groups are inputs and must not be changed in response to market outcomes.
Technical indicators describe market state; they are not intrinsic value estimates or trading signals.
Valuation multiples are displayed only when the economic function makes the denominator relevant and the required data are observed.
Missing data and economically inapplicable metrics are distinct states and neither is converted to zero.
No composite investment score, price target, recommendation, or asset ranking is produced.
